revenue.definition: Consolidated revenue from operations; excludes recovered GST and other income. Scope follows the cited statement, without an adjusted comparability assertion.

other_income.definition: Consolidated statement other income. Scope follows the cited statement.

total_income.definition: Consolidated statement total income, equal to revenue from operations plus other income.

finance_costs.definition: Full consolidated P&L finance-cost line; not interest_expense or a generic interest-coverage denominator.

total_expenses.definition: Consolidated P&L total expenses, not directors-report operating expenses or inferred COGS.

profit_for_year.definition: Consolidated group profit for the year including NCI; continuing/discontinued scope follows the cited statement. Not owner PAT/net_income, and not RIL's distinct pre-associate/JV Profit After Tax subtotal.
